Message:

>#make C=1 CF=-D__CHECK_ENDIAN__ drivers/net/wireless/mwl8k.o
>drivers/net/wireless/mwl8k.c:3089:6: warning: symbol 'mwl8k_update_survey' was not declared. Should it be static?
